title: feat(facek16): on B16, nu face reverse holds k=1..3 and fails k=4..8
science: Most informative k-sweep in the slice, and it CORRECTS an earlier result. Full face-reverse census k=1..8 on B_16(0): holds at k=1,2,3 and fails at k=4,5,6,7,8, with exact integer comparisons for every k. The k=6 'face reverse returns' reported on B_12(0) (see #6757) is shown to be a ball-boundary artifact: on B_12 the wall forces t(12,0,0)=20, while on B_16 the corridor hop (12,1,0)->(12,0,0) exists and t(12,0,0)=18, flipping k=6 to fail. Conclusion: the face reverse is a strictly short-distance effect that dies at k>=4 and never returns.
verdict_pair: face reverse by k: YES k=1,2,3; NO k=4,5,6,7,8
